baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Run pinned RTK 0.42.4 `rtk init --global --auto-patch` with lane-private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; require the generated Claude settings hook, RTK.md, and global CLAUDE.md before execution.

reset.policy: Delete lane-private Claude config, RTK hook/settings, RTK.md, global CLAUDE.md, cache, and generated state after evidence capture; verify no RTK state survives into another lane.

registry_entry.notes: Claude Code-specific RTK treatment. Measures the official native Claude PreToolUse hook and product-authored global instruction layer, separate from terminal-rtk-codex-instructions-v1.

tool_config.display_name: RTK Claude Code native hook and instruction policy v1

network_isolation.model_shell_enforcement: seccomp denies AF_INET and AF_INET6 socket creation for the shell process and descendants

runtime.isolation_policy: fresh lane-specific agent home/XDG state; provider-only network with model shell and agent web tools disabled; sequential one-task prompt delivery; controller seed/verifier scripts excluded while controller-only compile and essential-smoke commands retained; no acceptance-test assets injected; agent prompts carry normal software objectives

baseline_pool_reference.comparison_policy: paired baseline and treatment must share this baseline pool fingerprint and replicate

tool_config.display_name: RTK Claude Code native hook and instruction policy v1

token_usage.agent_step_definition: count of completed agent items (agent_message, command_execution, file_change, todo_list)

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Future semantic regression code is present from lane start. Agent prompts state normal software objectives and do not disclose controller scoring. Compile, essential-smoke, and controller verifier commands remain controller-only; no acceptance-test assets are injected.
Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered cumulative checkpoints plus final cumulative source diff from one composite root
